title: Schedule of Agreement Fees: Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements
content:
Fees under the Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements, by tier. Amounts are in US dollars.

| Tier | Annual fee per 12-month term | Included sites | Additional site fee, per property beyond the included sites, per term | Proration basis days | Free covered-property list changes per term | Site change fee per change beyond the free changes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ready Profile Service Agreement | 0.00 | 5 | 0.00 | 365 | 2 | 0.00 |
| Silver Priority Service Agreement | 495.00 | 2 | 145.00 | 365 | 2 | 35.00 |
| Gold Priority Service Agreement | 1,250.00 | 5 | 115.00 | 365 | 4 | 35.00 |
| Platinum Priority Service Agreement | 2,850.00 | 10 | 95.00 | 365 | 6 | 35.00 |
| Portfolio Master Service Agreement | 6,400.00 | 25 | 65.00 | 365 | 12 | 25.00 |
| Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 365 | 0 | 0.00 |

Figures shown without separators: Gold annual fee 1250, Platinum annual fee 2850, Portfolio annual fee 6400.

## Column notes

- **Annual fee**: the agreement fee per 12-month term, billed at the start of each term.
- **Included sites**: the number of properties covered by the annual fee.
- **Additional site fee**: the fee per covered property beyond the included sites, per term.
- **Proration basis days**: the days in the proration year used to prorate the annual fee; the figure is 365 at every tier.
- **Free covered-property list changes**: the number of times the covered-property list may be changed in one term without a site change fee.
- **Site change fee**: the fee per covered-property list change beyond the free changes.

## Points of comparison

- The Ready Profile Service Agreement carries no annual fee, no additional site fee and no site change fee: all three are 0.00.
- Among the fee-bearing property tiers, the additional site fee falls as the tier rises, from 145.00 at Silver Priority to 65.00 at Portfolio Master, while the included sites rise from 2 to 25.
- The Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement shows 0.00 or 0 in every column.
